Info.location: If you allow location access, the app uses your coordinates to search for and show nearby carts. If you use your location while adding a listing, review the pin before publishing the cart’s location.
Info.account: The app uses your phone number to sign you in and lets you provide an optional email address. A session cookie keeps you logged in.
Info.public: Listing details, reviews, reviewer names, and photos can appear in the public directory. Share information and photos you have permission to publish.
Info.accuracy: Community members contribute listings and reviews. Locations, prices, and hours can change. Use the listing’s available contact details to check before visiting.
Info.contributions: Share first-hand reviews, accurate listing details, and photos you have permission to publish. Use the report action if you notice incorrect information.
Info.moderation: Moderators can review reports, hide photos or reviews, and change listing or account status.
Info.contactBody: For questions about the app or to report a technical problem, open an issue in the project’s GitHub repository.
Info.contactListing: For incorrect cart information, open the listing and choose Report listing.
